plan.title: Select existing event for counter offer

steps.note: Open the Events list to choose an existing event.
Ensure counter offers are available on RFQ events as required by the case.
Confirm the Events list and its controls rendered successfully.
Restrict selection to events in the live or evaluation area rather than drafts or history.
Open the first existing live event available for this test.
Check that the opened event shows the expected live-state indicator.
Open the event's Responses view to inspect the bid source.
Verify that at least one vendor response exists and that at least one is a direct vendor bid, with no surrogate response counted.
Read the selected event title for the available Test Data entry.
